texte.Ce qu un certificat ISO # ou ISO/IEC # a: What an ISO # or ISO/IEC # certificate already gives you, what it does NOT, and the other harmonised standards of the family.
texte.Fournisseur ou deployeur : la norme adre: Provider or deployer: the standard addresses its requirements to the provider, and passes them to the deployer through the instructions for use. The questionnaire follows your role.
texte.L article # alinea par alinea, et le par: Article # point by point, and the clause of the standard that covers it. One row stays uncovered: Article #(#).
texte.La qualification, les cinq composantes d: The classification, the five parts of the strategy, and the approach taken for each of the seven essential requirements. The approach governs the burden of proof.
texte.Le questionnaire de votre role, paragrap: Your role's questionnaire, clause by clause, with what each point is there to prevent and the pitfall seen in the field.
texte.Le score de conformite, ses plafonds, la: The compliance score, its caps, the documentation required, and Article # coverage point by point.
texte.Le taux de chacune des quatorze normes,: The rate for each of the fourteen standards, and the plan that raises it
texte.Les # actions suggerees d AI #-# : elles: The # suggested actions of AI #-#: they cap the framework's rate as soon as the system is declared generative
texte.Les soixante-cinq paragraphes normatifs,: The sixty-five normative clauses, from the management system to performance evaluation.
texte.Replier ou deplier prEN # : le systeme d: Collapse or expand prEN #: the quality management system Article # of the AI Act requires of the provider of a high-risk AI system.
texte.Replier ou deplier prEN #-# : la supervi: Collapse or expand prEN #-#: human oversight of AI systems, in support of Article # of the AI Act.
texte.Un scenario de risque, son delai de reac: A risk scenario, its reaction time, the measure category chosen, and the intervention latency you measured. The engine compares the two figures you declare.
